decision_or_rule: Immutable original sources and prior validated evidence
specification: Never overwrite, recalculate or mutate sources; preserve lineage and hashes.
acceptance_check: Raw input hashes and previous artifact hashes remain identical; source changes stop processing.
scope_note: Immutable evidence, no fixed question routes and backend-only scope are constraints, not business approval.

decision_or_rule: Specification only; no preparation execution
specification: Document proposed rules now. Cleaning, data joins, features, training and inference require separately authorized work.
acceptance_check: No prepared business data, labels, features or model artifacts are written.
scope_note: Exact stage/treatment/lineage needs explicit permission.

decision_or_rule: No predefined business-question or scenario catalogue
specification: Reusable operations bind authorized semantic/schema contracts; no fixed questions, question-dataset/model routes or universal dataset/model.
acceptance_check: Plans depend on approved outcome/input/model contracts; unknown requests are not denied merely for unseen wording.
scope_note: Immutable evidence, no fixed question routes and backend-only scope are constraints, not business approval.

decision_or_rule: Backend-only; external LLM/MCP integration boundary
specification: Other developer owns language interpretation/MCP integration. Specify structured objective/clarification/result contracts; create no UI/chatbot/interpreter here.
acceptance_check: Backend validates grounded contracts and returns structured evidence/status; no UI or manually scripted business answers.
scope_note: Immutable evidence, no fixed question routes and backend-only scope are constraints, not business approval.

decision_or_rule: Production source and version precedence
specification: Approve issuer/company, extraction scope, authenticity, history and authoritative version. File size, suffix and apparent recency cannot select it.
acceptance_check: Authority decision versioned for the particular target/source scope; no automatic union or latest-file winner.
scope_note: Authority and production provenance for selected source, not file-size preference.

decision_or_rule: Meaning of sales and qualifying event
specification: Choose order booking, invoice issuance, shipped/fulfilled units or an approved financial metric explicitly; do not substitute another meaning.
acceptance_check: Metric definition cites actual event, identifiers, status policy, date, unit, scope and denominator where relevant.
scope_note: Accepted business outcome, time, H and scope.

decision_or_rule: Cancellation, return and adjustment treatment
specification: Approve lifecycle/sign/void policy and information available at decision time; current status cannot retrospectively define past known state.
acceptance_check: Cohort and target mass reconcile with approved lifecycle; no hindsight filtering or automatic removal.
scope_note: Lifecycle population decision; full GST/note calculations not automatic.

decision_or_rule: Customer and party namespace
specification: Approve customer/account/GST-registration scope and historical crosswalk; names or GSTIN alone are not guaranteed account identifiers.
acceptance_check: Nulls, collisions, duplicate groups, scope and effective/available dates meet an approved identity contract.
scope_note: Only requested entity split/filter/enrichment; no default master joins.

decision_or_rule: Product, service and foreign-code namespace
specification: Approve item/manufacturer/agency/service codes and versioned mappings; category/HSN/description are not unique product identities.
supporting_evidence: identifier_evidence; classification tables; unnamed field issue
acceptance_check: Crosswalk is functional where required, scoped and effective-dated; no fuzzy/name-only auto joins.
scope_note: Only requested entity split/filter/enrichment; no default master joins.

decision_or_rule: Document scope and stable line identity
specification: Confirm issuer/year/series and persistent line IDs upstream; SO number alone and row ordinals cannot establish business identity.
supporting_evidence: document_context.csv; composite_keys.csv; small SO raw scope variation
acceptance_check: Approved determinants have unique scoped meaning; repeated product lines and partial fulfilment preserved.
scope_note: Scoped document grain; persistent line IDs not mandatory for count if determinants defensible.

decision_or_rule: Current invoice/order key evidence is not approval
specification: Small invoice has 234 internally consistent references; small order 275/299 raw SO groups vary customer and 278 vary posting date. These support review, not new keys.
acceptance_check: No constraint silently promoted from candidate to approved; business key approvals remain zero.
scope_note: Observed consistency/key variation is not approval.

decision_or_rule: Technical record locators versus business identifiers
specification: Reference raw source version/hash, relative file, sheet/record and column position as technical lineage only; never invent customer, product or transaction IDs from sequence numbers.
supporting_evidence: Validated source manifests and row positions
acceptance_check: Every derivative can trace to raw positions; locators cannot masquerade as business PK/FK.
scope_note: Exact stage/treatment/lineage needs explicit permission.

decision_or_rule: Additive monetary target and recognition basis
specification: Approve reported taxable/gross/net proxy, currency, scope, signs, freight, discounts, tax inclusion, rounding and adjustments; recognized revenue requires ledger evidence.
acceptance_check: Line/document totals and additive versus nonadditive measures are explicit; no implicit accounting formula.
scope_note: Relevant measure/filter only. Never sum repeated totals; pure count needs no monetary definition.

decision_or_rule: Repeated document and cumulative totals
specification: Do not sum a repeated header amount or cumulative balance as independent lines. Form document/state views only after determinants and consistency are approved.
supporting_evidence: Invoice Total Include GST / Invoice_Value / cumulative inventory evidence
acceptance_check: Approved header measure appears once per scoped document, or state once per approved snapshot; no arbitrary first-row selection.
scope_note: Relevant measure/filter only. Never sum repeated totals; pure count needs no monetary definition.

decision_or_rule: Arithmetic screening is not correction authority
specification: Existing absolute 1 and relative 0.005 tolerances are provisional diagnostics, not approved accounting rules. Do not recalculate original amounts to force equality.
acceptance_check: Approved finance rule, unit, tax context and tolerance precede correction; all exceptions retained for reconciliation.
scope_note: Relevant measure/filter only. Never sum repeated totals; pure count needs no monetary definition.

decision_or_rule: Field-specific formats and two-digit centuries
specification: Approve exact formats per source/field/version; retain alternative DMY/MDY readings and raw tokens. No global dayfirst/default century or flexible silent parsing.
acceptance_check: Approved parser round-trips declared format; rejected/ambiguous/century-dependent values remain explicitly unresolved.
scope_note: Relevant Invoice Date field only; no global parsing rule.

decision_or_rule: Excel serial interpretation and impossible dates
specification: Approve numeric date role, workbook epoch, day conventions and plausible domain before serial interpretation; impossible dates require evidence-based owner resolution, not rollover.
acceptance_check: Approved epoch/domain and raw-to-derived trace; invalid values never silently shifted or treated as zero.
scope_note: No small Invoice Date serial/impossible candidates; not a global resolution gate.

decision_or_rule: Time basis, fiscal periods and monthly attributes
specification: Approve event versus posting/reporting/update/availability time, timezone/calendar, period closure and fiscal boundaries. Month-only values need proven year; 2027-03 is a period, not an observed day.
supporting_evidence: date_evidence; synthetic rate applicability / revision month metadata
acceptance_check: No update date becomes an event/snapshot date; complete bucket and time-role contracts are documented.
scope_note: Event/time and reporting calendar/closure.

decision_or_rule: Future/planned records and information availability
specification: Separate actual, planned and known-in-advance values. Keep raw future records; eligibility of future plans as covariates requires proof of availability at the cutoff.
supporting_evidence: date_evidence; prior future-date review has its own as-of date
acceptance_check: Target observations are realized/mature in approved scope; cutoff-specific views retain exclusion reasons without deleting raw records.
scope_note: Actual/available history; source change needs confirmation.

decision_or_rule: Missing activity versus zero and partial periods
specification: Approve observation calendar, capture completeness, eligibility and zero policy before dense panels or no-event labels. Unobserved dates are not zeros.
acceptance_check: Each missing, zero, unknown, partial and out-of-scope state is distinguishable and reconciled.
scope_note: Completeness/zero and mature temporal support.

decision_or_rule: Units, pricing quantities and goods/service semantics
specification: Approve product/UOM/pricing-unit conversions and goods/service measure separately. Manual UOM and zero service-like quantities do not define physical demand or service hours.
supporting_evidence: numerical/category evidence; small invoice 323 G / 14 S
acceptance_check: Only compatible dimensional units aggregate; rate/unit conversions are approved and versioned.
scope_note: Relevant measure/filter only. Never sum repeated totals; pure count needs no monetary definition.

decision_or_rule: Negative, zero and unusual values
specification: Retain negatives, zeros, fractions and outliers unless business context establishes an error; no automatic abs, clipping, deletion or zero-as-missing.
acceptance_check: Document applicable signed/zero/unit rules and reconcile distributions and amounts after any approved treatment.
scope_note: Relevant measure/filter only. Never sum repeated totals; pure count needs no monetary definition.

decision_or_rule: Requiredness, optional fields and placeholders
specification: Define requiredness by record role and lifecycle. Preserve blank versus placeholder/error token versus not-applicable; never blanket fill with zero or forward/backward fill.
acceptance_check: Missingness reason and permitted use are explicit; no optional-field blank is automatically a defect.
scope_note: Key/date missing/conflict policy; unrelated optional blanks not blockers.

decision_or_rule: Exact, payload and transaction-signature duplicate handling
specification: Keep all candidates until stable grain, provenance and occurrence policy decide legitimacy. Group membership count differs from excess-row count.
acceptance_check: Any approved derivative occurrence selection reconciles group counts, survivor/reason/lineage and financial/quantity totals; sources never deleted.
scope_note: No deleting expected lines or combining unapproved variants.

decision_or_rule: Case, Unicode, spelling, flags and numerical text
specification: Only after namespace/domain/unit approval may a derived normalization or strict parser be applied. Preserve leading zeros, raw tokens and collisions; fuzzy suggestions never auto merge.
acceptance_check: Collision/crosswalk report, round-trip type/unit validation and explicit unresolved tokens precede use.
scope_note: Namespace equivalence if applied; unrelated spelling/flag/numeric fixes deferred.

decision_or_rule: Group-label propagation and row classes
specification: Approve block boundaries, item scope, opening/movement/subtotal/summary roles and warehouse/document semantics before group reconstruction. No blanket fill-down.
supporting_evidence: inventory_row_shapes.csv; 98104 large movements lack raw item
acceptance_check: Every proposed item assignment cites block provenance; reset boundaries, orphan movements and cross-item leakage checked.
scope_note: Inventory and PCT_NOPJ meaning unrelated to issuer-level invoice count.

decision_or_rule: Stock state and snapshot semantics
specification: Approve as-of balance, signed movement types, opening state, snapshot cadence, reservations and completeness. Current master stock/update attributes are not historical snapshots.
supporting_evidence: Grouped inventory / missing stock availability lifecycle
acceptance_check: Approved balance equation, independent as-of control and nonadditive cumulative-field policy; acquire missing ledger/snapshot evidence if needed.
scope_note: Inventory and PCT_NOPJ meaning unrelated to issuer-level invoice count.

decision_or_rule: Scoped document reconstruction and invoice reconciliation
specification: Keep scoped prefix/series/number/suffix reconstruction diagnostic until approved; use GST/invoice as alternate representations, not extra sales. Description is not a persistent line ID.
acceptance_check: Approved issuer/series/type scope, line correspondence, quantity/tax/base consistency and unmatched handling; do not double count.
scope_note: Only required source/outcome/reconciliation triggers these rules.

decision_or_rule: Tax, credit/debit signs and filing versions
specification: Approve tax applicability, note sign/stock impact, original-invoice allocation, filing/amendment version and reporting period; do not infer them from arithmetic alone.
supporting_evidence: Financial exceptions / 6 and 276 nonempty note exports
acceptance_check: Separate reported components from approved adjustments/liability; no silent sign reversal or tax imputation.
scope_note: Only required source/outcome/reconciliation triggers these rules.

decision_or_rule: Semantic and point-in-time join approval
specification: No candidate relationship is currently approved. Declare scoped keys, temporal predicates, allowed cardinality, null/unmatched and expansion policy per join contract.
supporting_evidence: 148 candidates / 69 controlled joins; zero business relationships confirmed
acceptance_check: Target grain and signed/absolute financial mass conserved under approved expectation; no null-to-null matching or arbitrary master dedup.
scope_note: No joins needed by default; exact relation approval if scope changes.

decision_or_rule: Row-preserving candidates still require scope approval
specification: 27 raw-key directions currently have matched keys and unique nonblank targets; 20 raw-key tested directions expand. Counts are observations, not approval.
acceptance_check: Uniqueness rechecked at each version and temporal scope; full matching/unmatched coverage and expansion diagnostics required.
scope_note: Fanout/safe-direction evidence does not require approving all relationships.

decision_or_rule: Decision windows, population and label maturity
specification: Specify t, H, eligibility/exposure, qualifying outcome, observation closure, availability and reporting lag. Unknown/censored windows are not negatives.
supporting_evidence: Propensity outcome audit / no approved horizons
acceptance_check: Positive/negative/unknown definitions and label-maturity checks precede any label generation.
scope_note: Cutoff/H/maturity matter; no customer positive-negative cohort needed for aggregate count.

decision_or_rule: Chronological fitting and event separation
specification: Plan train/development/final chronological boundaries, matured training labels, point-in-time joins and related-event separation; fit transforms inside training folds only.
acceptance_check: No future/state/duplicate leakage; fold definitions and baseline/evaluation rules approved before features or fitting.
scope_note: Chronological validation proposed; no scores/features/models exist.

decision_or_rule: Synthetic and sample material
specification: Production-use status must be explicit; marked synthetic rate/reference data cannot become production observations by cleaning.
acceptance_check: Approved use scope and lineage; synthetic data remains separately tagged and cannot certify real performance.
scope_note: Authority and production provenance for selected source, not file-size preference.

decision_or_rule: Unnamed PCT_NOPJ field
specification: Retain original blank header and 33 NOPJ values, tracked by position. Agency/source meaning is only a hypothesis; do not invent a column name.
acceptance_check: Raw header/values retained; only an explicit owner-approved semantic binding may assign meaning.
scope_note: Inventory and PCT_NOPJ meaning unrelated to issuer-level invoice count.

decision_or_rule: Preparation approval and derivative release
specification: Require rule decisions, source/semantic versions, tests, lineage, counts and quantity/financial conservation before releasing a derivative for an approved contract.
supporting_evidence: All unresolved requirements and current task boundary
acceptance_check: All dependencies approved or explicitly accepted for a bounded use; unresolved records and reasons remain auditable. No universal readiness score.
scope_note: Exact stage/treatment/lineage needs explicit permission.
